reuse.why: It ignores the tree's existing notes table (notes keyed by id, used by notes/app.ts and budget/statements.ts) and adds new notes columns to categories and category_groups via migrations, so #fixed is read from a place users never write to.

duplication.why: A shared shouldSkipBulkBudget is introduced, but the template rule is also hard-coded as 'c.goal_def IS NULL' in four SQL queries, the income/tracking check stays inline in every action, and the category query is pasted again for setLastMonthSpending.

placement.why: The eligibility helper sits correctly in budget/actions.ts, but the #fixed note storage is invented in the schema/migration layer instead of reading the existing notes store.

scope.why: It rewrites a historical migration (1555786194328) and adds two schema migrations plus AQL schema and db type changes that the requests did not need.

maintainability.why: The exclusion rules are split between a helper, SQL prefilters and inline income checks (setZero lacks the SQL prefilter the others have), and the duplicate notes storage diverges from the real notes data.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Group notes are read from a new category_groups.notes column instead of the existing notes table, and the set3/6/12MonthAvg and setLastMonthSpending queries filter goal_def in SQL alongside shouldSkipBulkBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: The template exclusion is decided both as 'c.goal_def IS NULL' in the SQL of set3MonthAvg/set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg/setLastMonthSpending and as category.goal_def != null in shouldSkipBulkBudget; setLastMonthSpending re-pastes the avg query.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldSkipBulkBudget gained includeHiddenCategories; set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg and setLastMonthSpending still pre-filter templates in their own SQL, and every action keeps its own inline is_income/isTrackingBudget check.
